sessionTimeoutMinutes.label: Terminal Session Persistence
sessionTimeoutMinutes.description: How long a disconnected terminal is kept alive on the server before it is closed. Min 1, max 1440 minutes. For sessions that must outlive this, enable Auto-Tmux on the host.

commandHistoryEnabled.label: Komut Geçmişi
commandHistoryEnabled.description: Komut geçmişi kaydına izin ver. Devre dışı bırakıldığında, host başına ayarlara bakılmaksızın geçmiş kaydedilmez.

commandHistoryForNewHosts.label: Command history for new hosts
commandHistoryForNewHosts.description: Whether new hosts start with command history on.

imageStorageMode.label: Storage Mode
imageStorageMode.description: Where pasted and uploaded terminal images are written. Auto picks by connection, Local and Remote (SFTP) are fixed.

imageLocalDir.label: Local directory
imageLocalDir.description: Absolute path on the Termix backend where local mode writes images. Never shown after saving. Empty uses TERMIX_IMAGE_DIR.

imageHostPath.label: Host path
imageHostPath.description: The host-side view of the local directory that terminal agents receive.

imageTtlMs.label: TTL (ms)
imageTtlMs.description: How long an uploaded image is kept, in milliseconds. Empty uses TERMIX_IMAGE_TTL_MS or one hour.

imageMaxCount.label: Max image count
imageMaxCount.description: Most images kept at once. Empty uses TERMIX_MAX_IMAGE_COUNT or 100.

imageMaxBytes.label: Max storage bytes
imageMaxBytes.description: Most bytes of images kept at once. Empty uses TERMIX_MAX_IMAGE_STORAGE_BYTES or 5 GiB.

sessionPersistence.label: Keep sessions after disconnect
sessionPersistence.description: Keep a disconnected terminal alive on the server for the time above, so reopening its tab picks up where it left off.

newHostAutoTmux.label: Auto-Tmux
newHostAutoTmux.description: Run new hosts' terminals inside tmux so sessions survive disconnects (needs tmux on the host)

newHostTheme.label: Theme for new hosts
newHostTheme.description: The terminal theme a new host starts with.

newHostFontFamily.label: Font for new hosts
newHostFontFamily.description: The terminal font a new host starts with.

newHostFontSize.label: Font size for new hosts
newHostFontSize.description: The terminal font size a new host starts with, in pixels.

enableTerminalToolbar.label: Enable Terminal Toolbar
enableTerminalToolbar.description: Show a quick-access toolbar docked to the active terminal for this host's tools and live stats

terminalToolbarPosition.label: Toolbar Position
terminalToolbarPosition.description: Where the toolbar sits in the terminal. You can still drag it from there.

terminalToolbarStartState.label: Toolbar Start State
terminalToolbarStartState.description: Whether the toolbar opens expanded or minimized when the terminal connects

terminalToolbarDisplay.label: Toolbar Display Mode
terminalToolbarDisplay.description: How toolbar buttons are shown. Last used keeps whatever you picked in the toolbar.

terminalToolbarShowStatus.label: Show Live Stats
terminalToolbarShowStatus.description: Show live host stats above the toolbar buttons in expanded mode

terminalToolbarFade.label: Fade When Idle
terminalToolbarFade.description: Fade the toolbar out until you hover over it

enableCommandHistory.label: Komut Geçmişi
enableCommandHistory.description: Geçmiş ve otomatik tamamlama için bu terminalde çalıştırılan komutları kaydet

enableTerminal.label: Terminali Etkinleştir
enableTerminal.description: Offer an SSH terminal for this host.

commandAutocomplete.label: Komut Otomatik Tamamlama
commandAutocomplete.description: Show autocomplete while typing if you press tab

localEcho.label: Local Echo
localEcho.description: Reduce perceived input latency using safe local keystroke prediction

sessions.title: Use live terminal sessions
sessions.description: Lets other features, such as session sharing and recording, reach your live terminal sessions.

history.title: Read command history
history.description: Lets other features, such as the AI assistant, read your command history.

hosts.localEchoDesc: Predict safe printable keystrokes locally on slow connections. Password prompts and control input are never echoed.
hosts.macOptionIsMetaShortDesc: Disable to type special characters (like @ or |) with the Option/Alt key on macOS instead of sending Meta
hosts.passwordPromptAutoFillDesc: Offer to fill in the saved password when the terminal asks for one. Turn off to never auto-fill any password on this host.

macros.title: Macros
macros.description: Run a saved series of commands in a terminal, and react to what the server sends back.
macros.emptyHint: Create a macro to automate a terminal flow, like logging in, restarting a service, or answering prompts.
macros.name: Ad
macros.nameRequired: Give the macro a name before saving
macros.deleteBody: "{{name}}" will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
macros.needTerminal: Open and connect a terminal first
macros.noSteps: This macro has no steps yet. Add one below.

send.label: Send command
send.help: Types text into the terminal, the same as if you typed it.

wait.label: Wait for output
wait.help: Pauses until the server prints the text you name, like a password prompt.

delay.label: Pause
delay.help: Waits a fixed amount of time before the next step.

if.label: If output contains
if.help: Checks everything the server has printed so far, then runs one of two branches.

repeat.label: Repeat
repeat.help: Runs the steps inside it a set number of times.

send.pressEnterHelp: Turn this off to type text without submitting it.

match.useRegexHelp: Leave this off to match the text exactly as written.
match.invalidRegex: Not a valid regular expression, it will be matched as plain text

errors.remoteServerRequired: Remote server required. Connect a remote server in Settings to use this connection type.
